baroqueart.exhibition.selectPrompt: Select an exhibition below to explore its themes, monuments, and objects.
baroqueart.home.databaseText: Search the full inventory by name, location, provenance, material, patron and more. Combine up to three keyword fields.
baroqueart.home.exhibitionsText: Discover curated virtual exhibitions exploring specific themes, monuments, and objects from the Baroque art collection.
baroqueart.home.intro: Discover Baroque Art presents a wide range of objects and monuments from the Baroque period, held in museums and historic sites across Europe and beyond. Explore the collection through the Permanent Collection browser or the full-text Database search.
baroqueart.home.partnersText: Meet the partner museums and institutions across Europe and beyond that hold and share the objects and monuments in the collection.
baroqueart.home.permanentCollectionText: Browse the collection by country, holding institution, or date range.
baroqueart.home.timelineText: Explore historical events by country and time period, and see the collection items linked to each period.
baroqueart.home.title: Welcome to Baroque Art
baroqueart.identity.title: Baroque Art
baroqueart.partner.introDiscover: Discover Baroque Art is a collaborative project bringing together museums and institutions from across Europe and beyond. Browse the partner museums that lend and hold the objects in the collection, or the partner institutions responsible for the monuments and historic sites.
baroqueart.pc.intro: Select a filter to browse the Permanent Collection. Choose a category below, then select a value and click **Browse**.
baroqueart.results.noEvents: No events match the selected filter.
baroqueart.search.intro: Search the collection by one or more keywords. Select the field to search in and enter a keyword for each row. Leave a row blank to ignore it. Optionally restrict results to a date range and/or a search language.
baroqueart.timeline.errorPeriod: Please select a valid time period (start must be before end).
baroqueart.timeline.errorSelect: Please select a country, or a start and end date.
baroqueart.timeline.intro: Explore historical events from the Baroque period. Select a country and/or a time period below, then click **Go**.
